camera_package: ARRI Alexa 35 look; Cooke S8/i spherical primes; subtle halation, gentle edge softness
colour_science: Warm Australian daylight, filmic contrast, rich-not-crushed blacks, controlled highlights, no teal-orange LUT
flare_rule: Exactly one orange element per screen (HooknLoop orange #E87722); everywhere else is calm neutral warmth

shots.purpose: Open on the unplaceable macro world; create curiosity before comprehension
shots.subject: Abstract landscape of pale hook-and-loop fibres
shots.action: Two soft fibre-fields drift slowly toward each other
shots.angle: Slight low, looking along the weave
shots.dof: Shallow but readable; focus travels with the fibre
shots.lighting: Single large soft source + negative fill; gentle rim
shots.palette: Bone white, warm grey, faint amber bounce
shots.design: Clean seamless; dust motes in light
shots.trans_in: Fade from black on a breath
shots.sound: Breath in; room tone; sub-bass swell
shots.gen: Magnific-forward: macro fibre still -> detail pass -> i2v slow push
shots.continuity: Fibre = black-grade HooknLoop under warm light; establishes the macro look reused in S02/S05/S10/S17

shots.purpose: The first CATCH — the mechanical event the whole film rhymes off
shots.subject: A single hook taking a single loop
shots.action: Hook reaches, hesitates, takes the loop; weave tightens
shots.lighting: Hard-ish key for specular fibre highlights + soft fill
shots.trans_out: Match-cut on the closing shape -> S03 hand
shots.sound: PRESS — low woody click; the signature
shots.gen: Highest-value hero still; conservative Magnific (preserve fibre geometry); i2v tiny motion
shots.continuity: Same fibre stock/light as S01; this catch-shape is reused as the reveal engine

shots.purpose: First micro->human rhyme; reveal the metaphor is about people
shots.subject: Child's hand closing into a parent's hand
shots.action: Small hand slides into and grips an adult hand
shots.size: Tight insert (hands, lower faces out of focus)
shots.lighting: Soft window light, negative fill camera-left
shots.palette: Warm skin, oat linen, pale timber
shots.design: Lived-in Aussie kitchen; toast, a school bag
shots.trans_in: Match-cut from S02 (shape of the catch)
shots.sound: Room tone, distant kettle, one bird
shots.gen: Hands are risk: tight framing, reference-locked hands, Magnific low creativity, QA fingers
shots.continuity: Parent hands + child recur in S04 and S15 (same wedding band, same freckles, same tee)

shots.purpose: First natural product interaction; introduce the black strip
shots.subject: Hands pressing a HooknLoop strip onto a school project
shots.action: Peel backing (soft RIP), press strip onto card
shots.palette: Black strip on cream card, warm timber
shots.trans_out: Soft RIP audio bridges to S05
shots.sound: Soft RIP of backing; paper; press
shots.gen: Product accuracy critical: black hook-and-loop weave visible, no fake sheen; Magnific conservative
shots.continuity: Strip dimensions/weave = master product spec (see continuity bible)

shots.purpose: Macro bridge; the texture of the cut; reset to micro scale
shots.subject: A field of loops compressing and springing back
shots.gen: Pure macro, AI-forgiving; i2v with speed ramp

shots.subject: Upholsterer's weathered hands
shots.action: Stitch sew-on tape to a furniture panel
shots.lighting: Big soft north window + practical bench lamp
shots.palette: Tan leather, hessian, brass, warm wood
shots.sound: Needle punch, thread pull, room tone
shots.gen: Older hands = more forgiving; reference-lock the craftsperson
shots.continuity: Craftsperson character C2; recurs only here

shots.subject: Sign-maker placing a panel
shots.action: Dot of hook-and-loop set behind panel; panel lifts to wall
shots.lighting: Cool-warm mix daylight through roller door
shots.sound: Panel set, soft PRESS; PIANO IN (felt, single notes)
shots.gen: Panel/dot geometry accurate; watch background text (blur/avoid legible logos)

shots.purpose: World 3 — construction/cable management; rip-press on the beat
shots.subject: Electrician's hands on a cable run
shots.action: Reusable straps cinch a cable bundle; RIP-PRESS-RIP
shots.sound: RIP. PRESS. RIP — locked to beat
shots.gen: Keep hi-vis muted so orange flare is saved for S09

shots.purpose: World 4 — automotive/trade; THE ORANGE FLARE; biggest rip
shots.subject: Hands throwing + cinching a heavy-duty strap
shots.action: Orange HD strap thrown over cargo, cinched hard
shots.lighting: Hard low dawn sun, long shadows, dust in light
shots.palette: Dusty warm; the ONE orange strap sings
shots.sound: Big satisfying RIP; strap tension creak; magpie
shots.gen: Hero flare shot; strap colour = #E87722 exact; Magnific preserve weave + buckle
shots.continuity: Orange = the single flare of the film; do not add orange elsewhere in-frame

shots.purpose: Macro rhyme — the strap cinch at 1000x
shots.subject: Hook drawing loop taut
shots.action: Same tightening motion as the strap, microscopic
shots.gen: Macro, forgiving; warmer grade than S02

shots.purpose: World 5 — medical/aged care; the tender human heart of the film
shots.subject: A carer fastening adaptive clothing for an older person
shots.action: Carer's hands gently fasten a soft hook-and-loop closure
shots.size: MCU hands; older person's face soft in bg
shots.palette: Cream, soft blue cardigan, warm skin
shots.sound: Quiet; birds; a soft PRESS; piano warms
shots.gen: Emotional peak of human beats; two consistent people = highest QA; reference-lock both, tight framing
shots.continuity: Characters C5 (carer) + C6 (elder); dignity, never pity; no eye-contact-to-camera

shots.purpose: World 6 — schools; a wall of small connections
shots.subject: Children pinning cards to a display board
shots.action: Small hands press cards onto dots on a board
shots.movement: Dolly right; child crosses for wipe
shots.design: Display board, artwork, no legible brand text
shots.gen: Multiple kids = crowd risk; keep bg children soft/few; avoid faces to camera
shots.continuity: Background world only; no named child recurs

shots.subject: Hands re-packing + strapping caravan gear
shots.action: Gear strapped down; a door closes; ready for the road
shots.palette: Dusty green gums, cream van, warm gold
shots.design: Caravan, awning, camp chairs, red dirt
shots.gen: Landscape more creative-license allowed; keep it un-postcard

shots.purpose: World 8 — warehousing/logistics; rhythm peaks then holds
shots.subject: Fast hands bundling with double-sided tape
shots.lighting: Cool high-bay + warm dock light spill
shots.trans_out: Hard cut to held silence -> S15
shots.sound: Rapid PRESS x3, then silence (music holds a breath)
shots.gen: Fast hands = motion-blur helps AI; blur carton branding

shots.purpose: THE RELEASE — the un-stealable beat; holds then lets go, cleanly
shots.subject: A parent's hands slowly peeling a strip away
shots.action: Tender slow peel; no tear, no residue; a room being changed
shots.lighting: Soft afternoon window; dust in beam
shots.palette: Warm neutral; faded wall mark where it held
shots.design: A child's room mid-change (growth chart, boxes)
shots.sound: One long soft RIP; music at its most tender
shots.gen: Show clean separation, NO damage/residue (core product truth); Magnific conservative on the weave
shots.continuity: Same parent hands (band/freckles) as S03/S04; emotional payoff

shots.subject: Same hands pressing the strip in a new place
shots.gen: Press = same catch motion as S02; sets up the hero
shots.continuity: Same strip + hands; completes hold->let go->hold again

shots.purpose: HERO — the frame people remember; one unbroken push through the material
shots.subject: Hook drawing loop taut, then a continuous morph through a life
shots.action: Camera pushes THROUGH the contact point; fibres resolve, unbroken, into cable run -> garment seam -> ute strap -> two hands meeting
shots.sound: Music swells then drops away; heartbeat under
shots.vo: "Turns out the smallest connections hold the most."
shots.gen: Most complex: build as 3-4 chained i2v morphs, best-frame extract, Magnific stitch; the signature sequence
shots.continuity: Cameos must match earlier worlds' palettes (cable=S08, seam=S06/S11, strap=S09 orange, hands=S03)

shots.purpose: Breath of white silence before the brand
shots.subject: Warm white field
shots.action: Everything settles to warm white; stillness

shots.subject: Two black strips + wordmark
shots.action: Two strips enter from opposite edges, meet centre, PRESS; wordmark resolves
shots.product: The two strips = the logo moment
shots.palette: Warm white ground, black strips, blue wordmark, orange n
shots.gen: 100% deterministic compositing (FFmpeg/After Effects). Logo + type NEVER generated by AI.
shots.continuity: Logo = supplied SVG (blue #003B98, orange n #E87722, grey .com.au #8A8B8E); never distort
